title: Mission HUD AppSpec — Library Descriptor
description: Schema for a component library descriptor. A library descriptor enumerates the components a library exposes, their properties + variants, and (critically) the nativeMapping table that tells consumers how to materialise each component in concrete output targets — SwiftUI source, Compose source, React runtime mounting, etc. AppSpec instances reference libraries via libraryRefs.components; the descriptor IS the contract for what those references resolve to.

$id.description: Library identifier. Matches the value used in AppSpec libraryRefs.components. Examples: missionhud-default, ios-18, material-3, shadcn-ui.

$version.description: Semantic version of the library descriptor.

$kind.description: Optional. 'abstracted' = library uses synthetic component names that need translation per stack (e.g., missionhud-default/HeroCard). 'native' = library uses the target platform's actual component vocabulary so codegen + runtime can do 1:1 mapping (e.g., ios-18/NavigationStack, shadcn-ui/Card).

primitives.description: Optional. Catalogue of primitive element types the library exposes (Text, Image, Stack, etc.) — used for sub-component instance-swap support.

components.description: The library's components, keyed by slug. componentRef strings in AppSpec resolve as <library $id>/<slug>.

$extensions.description: Vendor namespace for extension fields. Use reverse-DNS (e.g., $extensions['com.missionhud']).

Component.description: One component in the library — its property schema, variants, and (load-bearing) nativeMapping table.

category.description: Optional grouping label (e.g., navigation, input, layout).

properties.description: Schema for the component's properties (slot values). Keys are property names; values describe each property's type, constraints, and default.

variants.description: Schema for variant properties (style, size, layout flavour). Distinguished from properties because variants typically map to design-tool variant axes and to platform-specific style modifiers.

supportsItems.description: Whether this component accepts an items[] array (repeating pattern — ProductCard grids, FeedPostItem lists, etc.).

nativeMapping.description: How this component materialises in concrete output targets. Codegen consumers (Builder's SwiftUI/Compose pipelines) read the per-language slots. Runtime consumers (@missionhud/appspec-runtime-react walker, future Vue/Svelte walkers) read the runtime-* slots. Same descriptor serves all output modes.

PropertyDefinition.description: Definition of one property a component accepts.

instanceSwapOf.description: For type='instanceSwap': the componentRef pattern (e.g., 'missionhud-default/Image') restricting what kinds of nested instances are valid here.

NativeMapping.description: Per-target instantiation map. Each key is a target identifier (swiftui, compose, react-native, runtime-react, etc.); the value is a NativeTarget describing how to produce that target. A component MAY ship mappings for any number of targets; consumers pick whichever target they need.

NativeTarget.description: How a single component materialises in one concrete target.

kind.description: 'codegen' targets emit source code (a string template a generator can fill in). 'runtime' targets refer to a runtime registry where the component is already implemented and gets mounted live.

import.description: Codegen targets: the import statement (or several, separated by newlines) the generator should emit at the top of the file.

instantiation.description: Codegen targets: a template string with $-prefixed placeholders that match AppSpec property names. Example for swiftui: 'NavigationStack { $children }.navigationTitle($title)'. Generators substitute placeholders with concrete values from each AppSpec instance.

componentName.description: Runtime targets: the name of the registered component to mount. The runtime walker looks this name up in its registry.

registry.description: Runtime targets: which registry package contains the implementation. The walker is configured with one or more registries at boot; this hint tells consumers which registry must be installed/registered for this library's components to work.

propertyMap.description: Optional. Maps AppSpec property names to target-specific names. Defaults to identity (AppSpec 'title' → target 'title'). Use when the target's API uses a different property name (e.g., shadcn-ui's Card might call it 'header' instead of 'title').

valueTransforms.description: Optional. Per-property transform expressions for values that need conversion (e.g., AppSpec stores a DTCG token ref '{color.primary}' but the target needs a literal CSS variable 'var(--color-primary)'). Each value is an expression name registered in the consumer's transform registry.
